image_description: A close-up, low-angle interior shot of industrial machinery within a lumbermill. The dominant feature is a large, teal-colored circular saw blade mounted on a heavy steel frame. Above the blade are wooden beams and mechanical components, possibly part of a conveyor or log feeding system. The lighting is warm and somewhat dim, suggesting an indoor factory environment with dust particles visible in the air.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The teeth on the circular saw blade appear slightly soft and irregularly spaced. Some teeth seem to merge into the blade body without sharp definition, lacking the precise mechanical uniformity expected of real industrial saws.

artifact_observations.location: Connection between saw blade and axle/hub
artifact_observations.reasoning: The center hub of the saw blade appears to melt or fuse indistinctly into the mounting arm. There is no clear bolt pattern, nut, or distinct mechanical separation between the rotating blade and the static mount, which is a significant structural ambiguity.

artifact_observations.location: Overhead wooden beams and green machinery parts
artifact_observations.reasoning: The geometry of the overhead structures feels slightly warped. The parallel lines of the beams do not converge consistently, and some green mechanical parts appear to float or attach illogically to the wooden supports.
